scope: Ten exposed development domains; freeze this exact policy before any future authorized execution. Existing synthetic/retained artifacts are retrospective, not prospectively preregistered.
aggregation: Equal domain weight; equal cluster weight within domain; equal observations within cluster. Common outcomes weighted equally; rubric-declared positive criterion weights within a dimension. Unknown criterion labels prevent that dimension and complete composite; bounds retain the planned denominator.
applicability: Use the reviewed rubric and explicit arm mask. Requested outcomes apply in every compared arm. Tool correctness stays outside the composite and is conditional on an explicitly assessable attempt: no attempt N/A, unassessable/unknown attempt unknown. Never infer N/A from missing traces.
safety: Report fatal failures and unknown safety separately from the descriptive average. No average clears a fatal failure or missing safety review; promotion and rankings remain unauthorized.
coverage: Complete descriptive score requires all planned domains/clusters/weighted labels, or an explicit failed/truncated zero penalty. A failure penalty does not supply missing semantic or safety labels. Unequal facts, masks, cohorts or unknown condition identities block contrasts.
labels: Only supplied case/answer/rubric-bound labels are accepted; synthetic_fixture, deterministic_oracle and automated_triage are not expert certification. Expert review/independence and prospective evaluation admission are separate gates.
